subject: general
question: A conical cap has the base diameter 40 cm and height 21 cm. What is the cost (rounded off to one decimal place) of painting the surface of the cap at the rate of 112 paise per sq. cm? (Use pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The radius (r = 20) and height (h = 21) form a standard Pythagorean triplet (20, 21, 29) with the slant height (l), so l = 29 cm.

A cap is open at the base, meaning we only need to calculate and paint the Curved Surface Area (CSA).

CSA = πrl = (22/7) × 20 × 29 cm²

Cost = CSA × Rate = (22/7) × 20 × 29 × 1.12 (since 112 paise = ₹1.12)

Cost = 22 × 20 × 29 × 0.16 = ₹ 2,041.6

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 2,041.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
• h = 21 cm r = 20 cm l = 29 cm 

**Given:**

Base diameter = 40 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 20 cm

Height (h) = 21 cm

Rate of painting = 112 paise/cm² = ₹1.12/cm²

**Formula Used:**

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²)

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl

Total Cost = CSA × Rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ l = √(20² + 21²)

⇒ l = √(400 + 441) = √841 = 29 cm

⇒ CSA = (22/7) × 20 × 29

⇒ CSA = 12760/7 cm²

⇒ Total Cost = (12760/7) × 1.12

⇒ Total Cost = 12760 × (1.12/7)

⇒ Total Cost = 12760 × 0.16

⇒ Total Cost = 2041.6

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 2,041.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cone

The volume represents the 3D space enclosed by a cone. Formula: V = (1/3)πr²h

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cone

This includes the curved surface and the solid circular base. Formula: TSA = πr(r + l)

Pythagorean Triplets in Geometry

Common sets of integers that satisfy a² + b² = c² help speed up calculations heavily. Examples include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (20, 21, 29).
